characteristic_extramedullary_sites: CNS (particularly in high-WBC/hyperleukocytic disease and at relapse; overall uncommon at presentation)

biomarkers.name: t(15;17) PML-RARA fusion
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defining event in classic APL. ATRA + arsenic trioxide is standard curative therapy (>90% cure in non-high-risk disease and very high cure rates overall in modern protocols; Lo-Coco APL0406 established chemotherapy-free ATRA+ATO for non-high-risk APL). MRD monitoring by RQ-PCR

biomarkers.name: Variant RARA fusions (PLZF-RARA, NPM-RARA, NuMA-RARA, STAT5b-RARA)
biomarkers.clinical_use: PLZF-RARA (ZBTB16-RARA) is classically resistant to ATRA and arsenic trioxide — critical to distinguish from PML-RARA

biomarkers.name: FLT3-ITD
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associates with hyperleukocytosis/microgranular variant and adverse presentation features including increased early hemorrhagic risk

biomarkers.name: Sanz risk score (WBC and platelet count)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Low (WBC ≤10, plt >40); intermediate (WBC ≤10, plt ≤40); high (WBC >10). Guides treatment intensity/risk stratification

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Hypergranular promyelocytes with numerous Auer rods ('faggot cells' — bundles of Auer rods), reniform / bilobed / dumbbell-shaped nuclei
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Not graded; Sanz risk score for stratification

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Not the paradigm — DIC/coagulopathy from procoagulant and fibrinolytic activity associated with promyelocytes is the defining pathophysiology, not immune interaction
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Marrow infiltration by promyelocytes; extensive Auer rod formation is hallmark

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: HSC or myeloid progenitor with maturation arrest at promyelocyte stage
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Uniquely arrested at promyelocyte stage with characteristic hypergranular morphology (numerous Auer rods, 'faggot cells' — bundles of Auer rods), reniform / bilobed / dumbbell-shaped nuclei
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: PML-RARA fusion (from t(15;17)) is defining lineage-locking event — recruits transcriptional co-repressors and epigenetic repressors to retinoid target genes, blocking terminal differentiation; ATRA reverses this repression and promotes PML-RARA degradation; arsenic trioxide targets the PML component directly
